title: PROVE: Probabilistic Visual Grounding via Patch-Level Evidence for Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.32440v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual grounding with vision-language models such as CLIP typically produces a single deterministic relevance map for an image-query pair, without indicating whether the localisation is reliable or whether the referent is present at all. We introduce \textbf{PROVE} (\textbf{Pro}babilistic \textbf{V}isual Grounding via Patch-Level \textbf{E}vidence), a post-hoc evidential adapter that maps frozen CLIP patch features to per-patch Beta distributions without modifying the backbone. PROVE casts grounding as per-patch membership: each patch accumulates positive and negative evidence for whether it belongs to the referent, so a query may match zero, one, or many patches. We train PROVE with an evidential objective on soft patch-coverage targets, and define a prior-pull objective that keeps absent-referent examples near an uninformative prior, so that vacuity serves as an absence signal without a dedicated presence classifier. translated_title: PROVE：基于补丁级证据的视觉-语言模型概率视觉定位
translated_abstract: 使用CLIP等视觉-语言模型进行视觉定位时，通常针对图像-查询对生成单一的确定性相关性图，而无法指示该定位是否可靠，或所指对象是否确实存在。我们提出了PROVE（基于补丁级证据的概率视觉定位），这是一种事后证据适配器，能够将冻结的CLIP补丁特征映射为每个补丁的Beta分布，而无需修改骨干网络。PROVE将定位任务转化为逐补丁的成员归属问题：每个补丁累积其是否属于所指对象的正负证据，因此一个查询可以匹配零个、一个或多个补丁。我们使用基于软补丁覆盖目标的证据目标来训练PROVE，并定义了一个先验拉近目标，使不存在所指对象的样本保持在无信息先验附近，从而使证据空缺性能够作为对象缺失的信号，而无需专门的存在分类器。在推理阶段
tldr: 提出PROVE，一种无需修改冻结CLIP骨干网络的事后证据适配器，通过将补丁特征映射为Beta分布并累积正负证据实现概率化视觉定位，同时利用证据空缺性作为信号判断所指对象是否存在，无需额外的存在分类器。
en_tdlr: PROVE is a post-hoc evidential adapter for frozen CLIP that maps patch features to per-patch Beta distributions for probabilistic visual grounding, using evidential vacuity as an absence signal without a dedicated presence classifier or backbone modification.
